newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mosel Vitelic unit US$ FRN group forming.
newsitem.headline: Mosel Vitelic unit US$ FRN group forming.

text.p: A co-arranger group is being formed for Mosel Vitelic's US$100 million floating rate note issue, bankers said Thursday
They said the issue will be launched into general syndication via a special purpose vehicle called Vision 2000 Ventures Cayman Island next week.
The deal is fully guaranteed by Mosel Vitelic.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in year three.
The issue was priced at par to float at 47.5 basis points.
With fees, all-in return to syndicate is at least 50 basis points, bankers noted.
Citicorp International, Credit Lyonnais and Taiwan Cooperative Bank are the mandated arrangers.
